text:
incident-bot: CRITICAL 026-03-15 10:07Z  Alert: sustained 5xx spike on inference-api-main (region: eu-west-1). Error rate >15% for 90s. Paging rotation: Priya (primary), Ben (secondary). War room: https://warroom.redwood.com/r/5829 

telemetry-bot: Signal summary: 5xx spike; increased model-load timeouts; connection resets to model cache. Aggregated logs attached.

Priya (oncall): Acknowledged. I'm oncall and joining war room. Setting owner=Priya for initial mitigation. Ben, please standby to take over if I need a sleep handoff.

Ben (pager): Here. If you need escalation to infra, ping me and I'll loop in Sam.

Priya (oncall): Quick check: traffic shift policy in eu-west-1 has fallback pool defined (fallback-eu-2). Planning to perform a controlled failover if drain doesn't help. Kicking off host health scan: `infra healthscan --pool inference-api-main --region eu-west-1` 

Luke (sre): I'll prepare status page and customer message. Proposed short status page text below; will wait for IC confirmation to publish.

Nora (comms): On deck for customer comms. Once status page is live I'll coordinate targeted outreach for any accounts with >=100 errors in the last 10m.

Priya (oncall): Host scan results: 3 hosts showing model cache misses and repeated `model_load_timeout` errors. I'll drain the 3 hosts sequentially. Starting with node-eu1-07.

Ben (pager): Reminder: follow the runbook and call out if you need the route flip. Route flip command is: `infra route promote --service inference-api --from main --to fallback-eu-2 --confirm`

Priya (oncall): Draining node-eu1-07 now: `kubectl drain node-eu1-07 --timeout=120s --ignore-daemonsets`. Monitoring error-rate...

telemetry-bot: After drain start: error rate lowered from 16.2% -> 10.8% in 60s. Latency still elevated.

Priya (oncall): Draining next host node-eu1-09. If error rate doesn't go below 5% after 2 drains we flip routing.

Luke (sre): Draft status page (short):
Component: Hosted Inference (eu-west-1)
Status: Degraded
Impact: Some requests may fail with 5xx or experience increased latency.
Action: Traffic is being routed away from affected hosts; engineers are investigating underlying cause. Next update in 15 minutes.
Incident ID: INC-2026-0315-2

Nora (comms): Customer email draft:
Subject: Redwood Inference: Service degradation in eu-west-1
Hi <Customer>,
We are currently investigating an issue affecting Hosted Inference in eu-west-1 where some requests may fail or be slower than usual. Engineers are routing traffic away from impacted hosts and are actively investigating. We will send updates within 15 minutes.

Priya (oncall): After draining 2 hosts error rate is 6.7% but still above baseline. I'm going to trigger the route promote in 30s unless anyone objects.

Ben (pager): No objections, execute the promote. I'll be ready to rollback if needed.

Priya (oncall): Executing route promote now: `infra route promote --service inference-api --from main --to fallback-eu-2 --confirm` 

telemetry-bot: Route promote executed at +240s. Error rate dropped to 1.1% within 50s. Latency returning to baseline.

Priya (oncall): Confirm mitigation: service stable for 5 minutes with error rate ~0.9%. No signs of customer data exposure. Moving to monitoring and RCA.

statuspage-bot: Candidate status update prepared. Waiting for comms owner approval.

Luke (sre): Approved to publish the status page update. Nora, you can run the email template and CS outreach to top affected accounts. I'll paste the status page link once live.

Nora (comms): Publishing status page now and notifying CS. Will update this thread with accounts contacted.

statuspage-bot: Status update posted: Hosted Inference (eu-west-1) 1: Service Degraded  Incident INC-2026-0315-2.

Nora (comms): Pushed targeted outreach to CS for accounts with >100 errors: acct-210, acct-581, acct-177. CS has been asked to contact them with the template.

Priya (oncall): Handoff: I'll remain primary for the RCA. Ben, please monitor overnight and be ready to take pager at 0200Z if needed. Luke, please own the post-incident sweep and logs collection.

Ben (pager): Acknowledged. I'll take over monitoring at 0200Z.

Luke (sre): Will collect logs, timeline, and start RCA draft. Expect initial RCA outline in 48 hours.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-2 moved to mitigated state. Next update scheduled in 3 hours or on any regression.
